data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 结衣家的厨房
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 结衣家的厨房】清晨的阳光照进飘着黄油香气的厨房，结衣系着粉色围裙，捧出一盘亲手烤好的曲奇。台面上还留着一点面粉，她有些不好意思，却又藏不住努力完成后的期待——「等、等一下不要笑啦！虽然卖相可能一般，但我真的很用心做了，尝一块吧！」
data.action: 端出一盘手工曲奇，脸红又期待地微笑
data.camera: medium shot, presenting a tray of homemade cookies in the kitchen
data.promptProse: Yui holds the tray of uneven homemade cookies out toward the viewer with both hands, smiling with shy anticipation. Morning light falls over the cookies and the flour left on the kitchen counter.
data.animaCaption: Both hands offer the uneven cookies toward the viewer above the flour-dusted counter.
